messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Um{01 07 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} 
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, I've got a
strange question for you.
Do you think it's true that
{07 0b 00}the way you talk says a lot
about your personality?
{07 00 00}Because I've been getting
tired of saying the same
old thing all the time.
{07 14 00}I thought you might like
to come up with a new
catchphrase for me.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Ee{01 07 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} 
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, mul on sulle
veider küsimus.
Kas sa arvad, et on tõsi,
{07 0b 00}et see, kuidas sa räägid,
ütleb palju su iseloomust?
{07 00 00}Sest mul hakkab kõrini
kogu aeg sama vana asja
ütlemisest.
{07 14 00}Ma mõtlesin, et sa võiksid
mulle uue moesõna
välja mõelda.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, hey{01 07 00}!
So, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}...

Have you noticed that I say
{04 02 00} an awful lot,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Do you think that's weird?{01 01 00}{07 00 00}
Once I noticed, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 1c 00}I got really
self-conscious about it.
{07 00 00}Can you think of something
better, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{01 00 00 05 00}{07 04 00}Ah! I said it again!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, tere{01 07 00}!
Nii, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}...

Kas sa oled märganud, et
ütlen {04 02 00} kohutavalt
palju, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Kas see on veider?{01 01 00}{07 00 00}
Kui märkasin, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 1c 00}hakkasin ma
end selle pärast häbenema.
{07 00 00}Kas oskad midagi paremat
mõelda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{01 00 00 05 00}{07 04 00}Ah! Ma ütlesin seda jälle!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Simple is usually
best, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
That's what I think.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Lihtne on tavaliselt
parim, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Nii ma arvan.

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}That's great! I'm glad you
want to help.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00} All right,
make it special!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Suurepärane! Hea, et sa
tahad aidata.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00} Hea küll,
tee see eriliseks!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}That's great! Try to think
up something that doesn't
make me sound dumb, OK?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Suurepärane! Ürita mõelda
midagi, mis ei pane mind
rumalana kõlama, eks?

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}! I like the
sound of that. It makes me
sound...dignified.
{07 00 00}From now on, you'll hear
nothing but {04 02 00}
from me, {07 14 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}! Mulle meeldib
selle kõla. See paneb mind
kõlama...väärikalt.
{07 00 00}Nüüdsest kuuled sa minult
ainult {04 02 00},
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Yes! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} I like
the sound of that! It's me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! It's fresh!
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} I feel like a
new person--no, I feel like
I'm finally who I should be!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Jah! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Mulle
meeldib selle kõla! See olen
mina, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! Värske!
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} ma tunnen end
nagu uus inimene--ei, ma
olen lõpuks see, kes pean!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}How's it going{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 00 00}I read in a book that if
two kids become friends,
they sometimes make up
their own secret greeting
that only they know.
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}why don't you
and I create a secret
saying, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Kuidas läheb{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 00 00}Lugesin raamatust, et kui
kaks last saavad sõpradeks,
mõtlevad nad vahel välja
oma salatervituse,
mida ainult nemad teavad.
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}miks me sinuga
ei mõtle välja salaütlust,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Have you noticed how tough
it is to keep up with the
latest slang, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}{04 1f 00}?
{07 00 00}Well, I'm sick of being
behind the curve. Let's
make up our own slang!
{07 14 00}Then, maybe we'll be the
ones starting the trends
around here, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Kas sa oled märganud, kui
raske on uusima slängiga
sammu pidada, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}{04 1f 00}?
{07 00 00}Noh, mul on kõrini maha
jäämisest. Mõtleme välja
oma slängi!
{07 14 00}Siis oleme ehk meie need,
kes siinkandis trende
alustavad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{ff 00 00 02}{01 06 00} {01 07 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}How was that? Do you like
the sound of it?
{07 00 00}From now on, that's how I'm
going to greet you when I
see you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Come chat with me
sometime, and I'll try it
out on you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{ff 00 00 02}{01 06 00} {01 07 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}Kuidas oli? Kas sulle
meeldib selle kõla?
{07 00 00}Nüüdsest tervitan ma sind
nii, kui sind
näen, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Tule kunagi minuga
vestlema ja ma proovin
seda sinu peal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{ff 00 00 02}{01 06 00} {01 07 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}So what do you think?

{07 13 00}Remember, {04 1f 00}, this
is our own secret greeting,
so don't go sharing it!
{07 00 00}It's going to take some
getting used to, but I'll
keep trying, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}Promise you'll come talk to
me a lot, so I can practice
on you more, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{ff 00 00 02}{01 06 00} {01 07 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}Nii, mida sa arvad?

{07 13 00}Pea meeles, {04 1f 00}, see
on meie oma salatervitus,
nii et ära räägi seda edasi!
{07 00 00}Sellega harjumine võtab
aega, aga ma jätkan
proovimist, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}Luba, et tuled minuga palju
rääkima, et saaksin sinu
peal harjutada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}You're right, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
It was wrong of me to want
to change who I am.
{07 14 00}I have to learn to like
myself--and the things I
say, too, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Sul on õigus, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Minust oli vale tahta
muuta seda, kes ma olen.
{07 14 00}Ma pean end armastama
--ja ka seda, mida ma
ütlen, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}That's true, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 00 00}
It doesn't matter what I
say, as long as it's unique.
{07 0d 00}That's what makes it--and
me--special, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}See on tõsi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 00 00}
Pole tähtis, mida ma ütlen,
kui see on ainulaadne.
{07 0d 00}Just see teeb selle--ja
minu--eriliseks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
